title: Define Index
description: As a database designer, I want to add indexes to columns so that query performance considerations are documented.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a table with columns exists, when the user adds an index, then the index is recorded and associated with the table

evidence: files: src/types/diagram.ts - added Index type, indexes array on Table, createIndex/findIndexById/findColumnById helpers, createTable initializes indexes: []

files: src/components/TableNode.tsx - added index management UI: IX badge on indexed columns, indexes section with add/edit/remove, column select for index target
files: src/index.css - added styles for index badge, indexes section, index edit row, index list, add/edit/remove buttons
files: src/hooks/useDiagram.test.ts - added 3 tests: add index to table column, remove index, update index name and column

failure 1: 'shows an IX badge on indexed columns' — getByTitle('IX') does not match title='PK IX' when column is also a primary key; test selector too strict

failure 2: 'adds a new index when Add index is clicked and form is submitted' — 'Add index' button is not rendered because the indexes section is conditionally hidden when table.indexes.length === 0 && editingIndex === null; FUNCTIONAL BUG: users cannot add their first index, violating the acceptance criteria

failure 3: 'removes an index when Remove is clicked' — removeIndex only passes { indexes: [] } to onUpdateTable, test expects { columns: [...], indexes: [] }; inconsistent with how column operations only pass the changed field

failure 4: 'edits an index when Edit is clicked and Save is submitted' — saveIndexEdit only passes { indexes: [...] } to onUpdateTable, test expects { columns: [...], indexes: [...] }; same inconsistency

typescript errors in new code: src/hooks/useDiagram.test.ts lines 195, 222, 250, 251 — Column object literals missing required 'primaryKey' property; src/ddl/ddlGenerator.test.ts line 139 — pre-existing test creates Table without now-required 'indexes' property

recommendation: (1) always render the indexes section / add-index button so the first index can be added; (2) fix test selectors/assertions to match implementation (getByTitle(/IX/), expect only indexes in update calls); (3) add primaryKey to Column literals in useDiagram.test.ts; (4) add indexes: [] to Table literal in ddlGenerator.test.ts
result: changes-requested — implementation does not meet acceptance criteria; 4 of 6 new index tests fail; functional bug prevents adding first index
